newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador to launch drive to modernize state sector.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador to launch drive to modernize state sector.

text.p: Ecuador will begin a drive to modernize state-owned companies concentrating on the telecommunications and energy industries, a top official said Thursday.
"We are not going to lose a day in modernizing the state so that Ecuador can start becoming a new country," said Omar Quintana, president of the National Council of Modernization of the State.
"The Ecuadorian crisis is profound; I would say Ecuador is not a third world country, it's a fourth or fifth world country," he said.
The official said the plan was part of a wider program to transform the economy through privatization.
Ecuador already plans to privatize 35 percent of state-owned telephone company Emetel.
